name: crm
title: CRM
summary: A tiny CRM: contacts with notes, tags, and a timeline; the website contact form creates leads and emails the owner; lead stages (new, contacted, quoted, won, lost); follow-up tasks with due dates; CSV export; marketing consent records; per-contact data export. Managed in the branded admin. Orders and appointments from later modules land on the same timeline.
env: # CRM: who receives an email for each website message (comma-separated; defaults to SITE_EMAIL).
settings: # CRM module: recipients of the email sent for each website message.
# Website messages accepted per visitor address per hour.
